description: Enlargement of existing door opening to the rear garden and installation of a 1.5 m wide French door; construction of a glazed conservatory (3 m wide × 2 m deep × 2.5 m high) to the rear elevation; and raising the height of the left-hand side window on the rear façade at first floor level to match the height of the existing right-hand side window.
decision_conditions:
Your property falls within a Flood Zone and/or in an area where there is evidence of a risk from other sources of flooding, including surface water, ground water and sewer flooding therefore a Flood Risk Assessment (FRA) is required for your application.

Please mark the relevant box from the link below and submit.
